LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 15.1.1 EVENTS WITHIN THE CLASSROOM

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.1: Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Events within the Classroom
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Events within the Classroom, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you make an oral report presentation interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. outline the organisation of an oral report of events within the classroom

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Events within the Classroom in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 15.1.1 Events within the Classroom together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Digital Literacy is developed as the learner searches online for skis on preparing and presenting reports.

 Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as the learner evaluates the strengths and weaknesses of their peers’ oral

reports.

Values:
Love is enhanced as the learner portrays a caring attitude while evaluating the reports of peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Effective communication is enhanced as learners use verbal and non-verbal reporting skills.

Link to other subjects:

The learner relates the skill of oral report preparation and presentation to report presentation in Kiswahili.
